newsitem.title: USA: IBS Financial sets special cash div.
newsitem.headline: IBS Financial sets special cash div.

text.p: IBS Financial Corp said it will pay a special dividend of $0.25 a share on each share of its common stock on January 3.
The dividend, which is in addition to the company's regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 a share, will be payable to shareholders of record on December 16, the company said.
The company also said its regular quarterly dividend of $0.08 cents a share will remain the same.
The regular dividend is payable December 17 to shareholders of record as of November 25, the company said.
